raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.3.19"
  maturin_min: "1"
  maturin_max: "2"
  python_check_max: "3.14"
  # mangle (lib)(ssl|crypto).lib for ladybugdb to avoid:
  #  LINK : fatal error LNK1181: cannot open input file 'ssl.lib'
  mangle_win_libopenssl: |-
    copy "%LIBRARY_LIB%\libssl.lib" "%LIBRARY_LIB%\ssl.lib" && copy "%LIBRARY_LIB%\libcrypto.lib" "%LIBRARY_LIB%\crypto.lib"
  unmangle_win_libopenssl: |-
    del "%LIBRARY_LIB%\ssl.lib" "%LIBRARY_LIB%\crypto.lib"
  # posix-ish stuff
  grep_version: ${{ "grep -iE" if unix else "findstr /r /c /i" }} "${{ version | replace('.', '\\.') }}"
  # abi3audit
  abi3_ext: ${{ "pyd" if win else "abi3.so" }}
  unix_sp_dir: $(python -c "print(__import__('site').getsitepackages()[-1])")/pyrudof
  win_sp_dir: Lib\site-packages\pyrudof
  pytest_k: |-
    not pg_db_load_and_query

recipe:
  name: rudof-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/rudof-project/rudof/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 629410297dc34eaf70be634d8fa615bdffbdf4285a973847d5b013e143fe1dfb

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - package:
      name: rudof
    build:
      skip: not only_cli
      script:
        env:
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
          OPENSSL_DIR: ${{ '$PREFIX' if unix else '%LIBRARY_PREFIX%' }}
        content:
          - if: win
            then: ${{ mangle_win_libopenssl }}
          - cd rudof_cli
          - cargo install --no-track --locked --path=. --profile=release "--root=${{ PREFIX }}"
          - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
          - if: win
            then: ${{ unmangle_win_libopenssl }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        # fails with:
        #   thread 'main' (12097) panicked at cargo-auditable/src/collect_audit_data.rs:96:9:
        #   cargo metadata failure: error: cannot update the lock file $SRC_DIR/Cargo.lock because --locked was passed to prevent this
        #   help: to generate the lock file without accessing the network, remove the --locked flag and use --offline instead.
        # - cargo-auditable
        - cargo-bundle-licenses
        - make
        - pkg-config
        - if: win
          then:
            - perl
      host:
        - openssl
    tests:
      - script:
          - rudof --help
          - rudof --version
          - rudof --version | ${{ grep_version }}
    about:
      homepage: https://crates.io/crates/rudof_cli
      repository: https://github.com/rudof-project/rudof/tree/master/rudof_cli
      description: >
        rudof is a command-line tool to inspect and validate RDF data using ShEx
        or SHACL, and to allow conversion between different RDF data modeling
        languages like ShEx, SHACL, DCTAP, etc.
      license_file:
        - LICENSE-APACHE
        - LICENSE-MIT
        - rudof_cli/THIRDPARTY.yml

  - package:
      name: pyrudof
    build:
      skip: only_cli or (is_abi3 and not is_python_min)
      python:
        version_independent: ${{ is_abi3 }}
      script:
        env:
          CARGO: cargo-auditable-wrapper${{ ".bat" if win }}
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
          OPENSSL_DIR: ${{ '$PREFIX' if unix else '%LIBRARY_PREFIX%' }}
          PYO3_PYTHON: ${{ '$PYTHON' if unix else '%PYTHON%' }}
        content:
          - if: win
            then:
              - ${{ mangle_win_libopenssl }}
              - set CARGO_HOME=c:\.cg
              - copy "%RECIPE_DIR%\cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat" "%BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat"
            else:
              - cp "${RECIPE_DIR}/cargo-auditable-wrapper.sh" "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper"
              - chmod 755 "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper"
          - cd bindings/python
          - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check
          - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
          - if: win
            then: ${{ unmangle_win_libopenssl }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cargo-auditable
        - cargo-bundle-licenses
        - make
        - pkg-config
        - if: win
          then:
            - perl
      host:
        - maturin >=${{ maturin_min }},<${{ maturin_max }}
        - openssl
        - pip
        - python
        - if: is_abi3
          then:
            - python-abi3
      run:
        - python
    tests:
      - if: is_abi3
        then:
          python:
            imports: pyrudof
            pip_check: true
            python_version:
              - ${{ python_min }}.*
              - ${{ python_check_max }}.*
        else:
          python:
            imports: pyrudof
            pip_check: true
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pytest
            - if: is_abi3
              then:
                - abi3audit
                - python !=${{ python_min }}.*
        files:
          source:
            - examples/
            - bindings/python/examples/
            - bindings/python/tests/
            - rudof_lib/src/default_config.toml
        script:
          - python -c "print(__import__('pyrudof').__version__)" | ${{ grep_version }}
          - cd bindings/python
          - pytest -vv --tb=long --color=yes -k "${{ pytest_k }}"
          - if: is_abi3
            then:
              - cd "${{ "%PREFIX%\\" ~ win_sp_dir if win else unix_sp_dir }}"
              - abi3audit -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }} pyrudof.${{ abi3_ext }}
    about:
      homepage: https://pypi.org/project/pyrudof
      repository: https://github.com/rudof-project/rudof/tree/master/bindings/python
      summary: Python bindings for Rudof, RDF data shapes implementation in Rust
      license_file:
        - LICENSE-APACHE
        - LICENSE-MIT
        - bindings/python/THIRDPARTY.yml

about:
  license: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE-APACHE
    - LICENSE-MIT
  summary: RDF data shapes implementation in Rust
  homepage: https://github.com/rudof-project/rudof
